name: fetus_30wk
description: Literature reference values for a human fetus in utero at 30+0 weeks (~1.5 kg): healthy, appropriate for gestational age, singleton, mother at rest breathing air, not in labour (undisturbed in-utero values from cordocentesis, not cord gases at birth). Grades: A = human fetal data at ~30 wk, B = human fetal data from a wider GA band, a pooled synthesis or a short extrapolation, C = derived, method-dependent, or ovine (marked 'C ovine').
state: fetus in utero, 30+0 wk, 1.5 kg; placenta is the gas exchanger; fluid-filled lungs, no fetal breathing; wide-open ductus arteriosus and foramen ovale; amniotic environment ~37.3 degC

variables.label: Heart rate (CTG baseline)
variables.notes: 30-40 wk mean 141.6 +/- 7.6 (Suwanrath); baseline falls ~9 bpm from 24 to 40 wk (Amorim-Costa, Serra), so +3 at the young end. Averages quiet and active states.

variables.label: Systolic arterial pressure
variables.notes: Ovine: no human fetal arterial pressure exists. MAP 38 + ovine pulse pressure ~16.

variables.label: Diastolic arterial pressure
variables.notes: Ovine, see sbp.

variables.label: Mean arterial pressure
variables.notes: User decision 38. Wassink 2014 baselines back-calculated from occlusion peak and % of baseline: 0.6 GA ~36, 0.7 GA (104 d, ~human 28-32 wk) ~37, 0.8 GA ~44; Schröder 121-132 d 44-46 +/- 7; Unno: linear rise late in gestation. Human cross-check: Johnson 2000 ventricular systolic pressure rises 1.74 (LV) / 2.24 (RV) mmHg/wk to 29 wk (intercepts not readable).

variables.label: Pulse pressure
variables.notes: Ovine.

variables.label: PA minus aorta, mean pressure
variables.notes: Wide-open duct: no LV-RV pressure difference in direct human measurements (Johnson 2000). Fetal invariant (docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Atrial (central venous) pressure
variables.notes: Johnson 2000: both atria equal and constant 16-29 wk; the value itself is in the scanned PDF only (requested from the user).

variables.label: LV end-diastolic volume
variables.notes: RV EDV / 1.4 (Hamill RV/LV diastolic ratio). 4D-echo (STIC) volumes are method-dependent.

variables.label: LV end-systolic volume
variables.notes: RV ESV / 2.0 (Hamill systolic ratio).

variables.label: LV stroke volume
variables.notes: Doppler: 41 % x 425 / 145 bpm = 1.20 mL/kg.

variables.label: LV ejection fraction
variables.notes: Hamill LV 72 > RV 62; Simioni reverses the order (RV 71-73, LV 65-67); Esh-Broder ~55 at 16-26 wk. Ordering uncertain.

variables.label: RV end-diastolic volume
variables.notes: Zhang 2016 STIC controls, mean 30.2 wk: 3.54 +/- 1.50 mL -> /1.5 kg.

variables.label: RV stroke volume
variables.notes: Zhang 2.21 mL = 1.47 mL/kg; Doppler 59 % x 425 / 145 = 1.73.

variables.label: RV ejection fraction
variables.notes: Zhang 62.3 +/- 4.2; Hamill 62.4.

variables.label: TAPSE
variables.notes: Messing linear 3.6 (21 wk) -> 8.6 (39 wk) = 6.1 at 30 wk; Peixoto ~6.4.

variables.label: Combined ventricular output
variables.notes: Mielke 425 (Doppler, flat with GA), Kiserud 400; MRI at 36-37 wk 459-465.

variables.label: RV share of combined output
variables.notes: Mielke RV:LV 59:41 (ratio 1.42, GA-independent); Rasanen 60:40 at 38 wk.

variables.label: Pulmonary blood flow, share of CVO
variables.notes: Rasanen: 13 % (20 wk) -> 25 % (30 wk), flat after 30 wk; Mielke 11 % pooled over 13-41 wk; MRI term 16 %. Kiserud & Acharya: lung flow maximal at 28-32 wk.

variables.label: Foramen ovale flow (R->L), share of CVO
variables.notes: Rasanen 34 % (20 wk) -> 18 % (30 wk); Mielke 33 % pooled; MRI term 29 %. Identity: LV 41 = FO 21 + lungs 20.

variables.label: Ductus arteriosus flow (PA->Ao), share of CVO
variables.notes: Identity RV 59 - lungs 20. Mielke 46 % pooled; MRI term 41 %; Rasanen: unchanged with GA.

variables.label: Placental (umbilical) share of CVO
variables.notes: Kiserud 2006: ~32 % through the 2nd half, 21 % after 32 wk. MRI term 29 %. UV 120 / CVO 420 = 29 %.

variables.label: Umbilical vein flow
variables.notes: Rigano controls 131 +/- 33; Gerada 115-126 (19-39 wk); Acharya: flow/kg falls with GA; Sun MRI 36 wk 129 +/- 28.

variables.label: SVC flow, share of CVO
variables.notes: MRI 36-37 wk 29-30 % (137 mL/kg/min); ~125 mL/kg/min at CVO 420.

variables.label: Descending aorta flow, share of CVO
variables.notes: MRI term 55 % (252 mL/kg/min); includes the umbilical arteries.

variables.label: Cerebral blood flow
variables.notes: User decision: grade C derived. Sun 2015 cerebral DO2 implies the brain takes ~75 % of SVC flow (~95 of ~125). Far above the neonatal 25 mL/kg/min (big brain, low arterial O2 content).

variables.label: Ductus venosus shunt fraction of UV flow
variables.model_readout: none (no ductus venosus in the model)
variables.notes: Reference only: PL_UMB_VEN drains straight into IVCI, so 100 % of umbilical blood bypasses the liver. Known limitation.

variables.label: Ductus arteriosus diameter
variables.notes: Anatomy: Szpinda regression 0.2072 + 0.0935 x 30 = 3.01 mm. User decision: PA ~ Ao is the real target; the model's duct size is a calibration lever (term_fetus needed 6 mm because the duct resistance formula is over-restrictive).

variables.label: Foramen ovale diameter
variables.notes: Reference only: grows linearly with GA (Phillipos 1994); numbers not extractable from the abstract. FO size is not a split lever above ~2 mm (docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Umbilical vein SO2
variables.notes: Week-30 cordocentesis synthesis 85.3 %.

variables.label: Umbilical vein pO2
variables.notes: 5.30 kPa; biological SD ~1 kPa (CV 20 %).

variables.label: Umbilical vein pCO2
variables.notes: 4.75 kPa. At 30 wk ~equal to maternal placental venous blood (diffusion equilibrium).

variables.label: Umbilical vein base excess
variables.notes: Calculated (ecf BE) from pH/pCO2.

variables.label: UA minus UV pCO2
variables.notes: 5.5 mmHg at 30 wk. The archived fetus ran 19 mmHg (the largest known discrepancy in docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Ascending aorta (pre-ductal) SO2
variables.notes: User decision 67 (cordocentesis-based scheme, 30 wk). MRI at 36 wk 58 +/- 6 (later GA; MRI oximetry reads lower).

variables.label: Thoracic IVC SO2
variables.notes: Siggaard Fig. 1 (30 wk).

variables.label: SVC SO2
variables.notes: Siggaard Fig. 1 (30 wk), pO2 2.6 kPa.

variables.label: Descending aorta SO2
variables.notes: = umbilical artery (same blood). Ordering UV > IVC > AA > AD is the primary pass/fail.

variables.label: Hb-O2 P50 (standard)
variables.notes: User decision: same as preterm_30wk. Siggaard in-vivo half-saturation tension 2.7 kPa (20.3 mmHg).

variables.label: Hemoglobin
variables.notes: Nicolaides 1988 mean at 30 wk (-2 SD 11.6), rising ~0.2 g/dL/wk; Siggaard 8.4 mmol/L = 13.5 g/dL. Below preterm_30wk 15.5 (placental transfusion at birth).

variables.label: Hematocrit
variables.notes: Hb / MCHC ~33.

variables.label: Fetoplacental blood volume
variables.model_readout: sum of fetal + PL_* blood volumes / weight
variables.notes: User decision 115. MacGregor 1988 (isoimmunised, transfusion dilution) 94 mL/kg mean, falling with GA; ~123 in another alloimmunised cohort; classic estimates 110-120. Low bound widened to 90 at step 3.

variables.label: Fetal body blood volume
variables.notes: Fetoplacental minus the placental share.

variables.label: Placental share of fetoplacental blood
variables.notes: Archived fetus_30wk held 52 % before the placental scaling fix (docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Oxygen consumption
variables.notes: MRI 6.9 +/- 1.6 (36 wk); calorimetry 6.8; umbilical uptake 5.4-6.5; lamb 8.1.

variables.label: Respiratory quotient
variables.notes: Fetal lamb: glucose + lactate + amino-acid oxidation.

variables.label: Core temperature
variables.notes: 0.3-0.5 degC above the mother; ~85 % of fetal heat leaves via umbilical blood (lamb). Environment = amniotic fluid ~37.3 degC.

variables.label: Plasma glucose (UV)
variables.notes: Fetal glucose follows maternal and falls with GA; maternal-fetal gap ~0.7.

variables.label: Lactate
variables.notes: Stable across GA in AGA fetuses. Cord lactate at birth (~3.7) is a labour value.

variables.label: Fetal urine production
variables.notes: User decision: reference only, known limitation (model keeps the preterm 30 wk kidney, ~3 mL/kg/h). Touboul 22.2 mL/h at 30 wk; Rabinowitz 5 -> 51 mL/h (20 -> 40 wk). Hypotonic.

variables.label: Plasma creatinine
variables.notes: Equilibrates with the mother across the placenta.

variables.label: GFR
variables.notes: Reference only: not measurable in the fetus.

variables.label: Cystatin C
variables.notes: Reference only; GA-independent, does not cross the placenta.

variables.label: Crown-heel length
variables.notes: Reference only.

variables.label: Placental weight
variables.notes: Reference only; placenta:fetus ~0.21 at 30 wk.
